{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate by keeping highest sample_seq per patient_id
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Calculate response rate per site
response_rate_by_site = df_dedup.groupby('site')['responded'].mean().round(4)

# Print each response rate explicitly
for site, rate in response_rate_by_site.items():
    print(f"{site}: {rate}")

# Print the highest rate and site
highest_site = response_rate_by_site.idxmax()
highest_rate = response_rate_by_site.max()
print(f"Highest response rate: {highest_rate} at site {highest_site}")"}
